notes.title: Stories Are Live in Passion Rift!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44758768/0dbfc53f84fa01fa1bcd66124ab151e02c54079f.png[/img]

Your favorite Stars now have their own mini-arcs. Play through a short chain of tasks, grab rewards along the way, and unlock a special date + scene at the end. Simple, guided, and super satisfying.

🙋‍♂️ How It Works?
• Short & sweet: Each Story is a focused set of tasks you can clear at your own pace.
• Steady rewards: Every task gives a little something; finishing the Story unlocks the big finale.
• Play as you like: Tasks match what you already do (Adventures, merges, spending Energy, opening chests). Just keep playing and check off objectives.
• More time with your faves: Dialogues and a scene that spotlight the Star you’re following.

🎁 What You Get?
• On the way: Currency, items, and other handy goodies for each task you finish.
• The finale: A short date that leads into a scene: your reward for completing the Story.

So dive in, chase the rewards, and unlock the scenes!
Don’t let your favorite Star’s story pass you by! See you in game!

With intent, JNT Corp. Reality Division
Watching. Waiting. Always filming. 🎥

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3578240/Passion_Rift/]Passion Rift on Steam![/url]
